      We are excited to announce the addition of Eliott Nazarian as Co-Founder at LUPFR. Eliott will help shape the company’s strategy, partnerships, and expansion across Los Angeles and beyond. He is a licensed attorney, actor, entrepreneur, and entertainment professional, and brings a multidisciplinary perspective to building the brand - developing partnerships, structuring opportunities, and turning ambitious ideas into scalable ventures. With roots in LA’s creative community spanning music, nightlife, film, fashion, and media, Eliott is focused on growing LUPFR into a platform where culture, community, and business intersect.
